claims.text: The experiment used 451 news articles from 48 news outlets, both propagandistic and non-propagandistic.
The articles were annotated according to eighteen persuasion techniques identified by professional annotators.
The total number of technique instances found in the articles was 7,485, out of a total of 21,230 sentences.
